units.text: XII. Management Model for Implementing the Strategy
units.label: XII. Management Model for Implementing the Strategy

units.locator: XII. Management Model for Implementing the Strategy
units.text: The management model for implementing the Strategy comprises a set of interrelated mechanisms and is intended to ensure effective achievement of the Strategy’s goals.
units.label: XII. Management Model for Implementing the Strategy · “The management model for implementing the Strategy comprises a…”

units.locator: XII. Management Model for Implementing the Strategy
units.text: The Strategy is implemented by federal executive bodies, executive bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and state budget-funded institutions subordinate to them through legal, policy, organizational, information, production and other measures within their assigned powers.
units.label: XII. Management Model for Implementing the Strategy · “The Strategy is implemented by federal executive bodies,…”

units.locator: XII. Management Model for Implementing the Strategy
units.text: Spatial development is managed using digital technologies. The digital platform is the key element of the management model for implementing the Strategy.
units.label: XII. Management Model for Implementing the Strategy · “Spatial development is managed using digital technologies. The…”

units.locator: XII. Management Model for Implementing the Strategy
units.text: The Strategy’s main provisions and spatial development target indicators are taken into account when determining, in the unified plan for achieving the national goals, planned values of indicators used to assess the effectiveness of the highest officials of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and of their executive bodies, characterizing achievement of the national-goal indicators.
